purpose: Cinco propuestas fotográficas del hero dirigidas con Impeccable.

variants.title: M · Desvanecido lateral
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE desktop website HERO proposal for IMSS JSDP Sonora. Landscape 1600x1000, crisp readable interface, no browser/device frame.
Reference 1 is the COMPLETE OFFICIAL SITE LOGO, rasterized directly from JSDP-Sonora-11.svg. Place it intact as an image: IMSS emblem and lettering, vertical gray divider, green JSDP, dark-gray spaced Sonora, green/gold/gray underline. Preserve ALL parts, proportions, colors and lettering; never replace it with a generic IMSS logo or retyped wordmark.
References 2–5 are exactly: brown hospital="Unidades médicas"; white office="Unidades no médicas"; surgeons="Personas"; meeting="Coordinación". Use these actual project photographs.
White header: modest exact logo at left; navigation "Inicio", "Conoce la JSDP", "Estructura", "Documentos"; green "Iniciar sesión" at right.
Below it, ONE full-bleed photograph covers the ENTIRE hero. Photography must dominate; its subject remains clearly visible across most of the hero. Text sits directly on a SOFT WHITE GRADIENT fading into the photograph, never a hard card or separate text column. Text and logo stay solid and readable.
Hero copy verbatim: "Jefatura de Servicios de Desarrollo de Personal"; "Órgano de Operación Administrativa Desconcentrada Sonora del Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social."; green button "Conoce la JSDP" with arrow. Elegant serif heading, sans-serif body, institutional green. No new slogans, claims or metrics.
At the bottom, a subtle carousel rail shows "Unidades médicas", "Unidades no médicas", "Personas", "Coordinación", with the active label underlined; small previous, pause, next controls. This is a static design of an automatically rotating four-photo hero; do not show four photos at once.
ACTIVE SLIDE: reference 2, Unidades médicas. Place the exact site logo at medium size in the hero reading area at left, followed by heading, body and action, all left aligned. The photo of the brown hospital, palms and entrance fills the whole hero; keep architecture recognizable toward center-right. The soft white gradient is strongest at the far-left edge and becomes fully transparent by the center. Keep the faded reading area compact, under forty percent of the visual width. Natural photo colors on the right. This is the most restrained, clear variant. Active carousel label: Unidades médicas.
